selection.note: replicates share the same 12 dates and the same pixels: they are not independent; the rep range is design-level variability of the date draw, not a sampling CI

lodo.definition: d = held-out pre date minus mean of the other two pre dates, both from the same 8-run per-date means; sigma from the other two dates + held-out date dihedral variance; stable pixels only

crossfit_coverage_at_k_eff.note: k fitted on one checkerboard parity, evaluated on the other, both directions

one_sided_flag_rate_at_k2.definition: fraction of stable pixels with (mean of the other two dates - held-out date) > 2 sigma, i.e. the gate-style S = d > k sigma on data with no real change (a false-flag rate; every flag is false by construction)

keep_rule.rule: pooled LODO coverage of |d| <= 2 sigma for the selected estimator within +/- 2 pp of 95.45 %, OR the gap reported with its cause
keep_rule.cause_note: MISS reported. Diagnostics above separate a scale error (robust scale of z far from 1) from tail/heterogeneity or date-coherent effects (per-fold coverage and per-fold median d).

limitations: three pre dates only: leave-one-date-out has n_pre = 2 (1 dof) and 3 non-independent folds
block-bootstrap CIs resample space, not dates: they understate date-level uncertainty
December comparison is confounded by season
stable pixels lie inside the SR crop around the slide, outside the footprint and 1500 m disks
coverage on stable pixels says nothing about power on real change
CPU macOS run; SR determinism verified by step3 only on this platform

a5.s2_dates_estimated_across: dates (per-date mean over its 8 dihedral runs), never pooled runs
a5.n_pre_3_handling: shrunk/pooled estimator (local window or land-cover stratified); choice documented with reason
a5.coverage_metric: fraction of real stable pixels with |d| <= 2*sigma, d = held-out date minus mean of remaining pre dates
a5.keep_rule: empirical coverage within +/- 2 pp of 0.9545 for the new sigma, OR the gap is reported with its cause
a5.also_report: old-sigma coverage, effective k that would give nominal coverage, simulation bias of old vs new sigma
a5.stable_pixel_definition: outside 1500 m disk around the published slide coordinates and outside the footprint; valid on all dates
a5.network: none (cached data only). If more dates are needed, say BLOCKED and name the dates

selection.criterion: mean held-out Gaussian negative log-likelihood of d under N(0, sigma^2), sigma floored at noise.sigma_floor
selection.tie_rule: winner = lowest mean NLL; if the paired per-replicate NLL difference vs the runner-up has a 95 % CI containing 0, take the simpler of the two (order raw < window < eb_stratified < eb_window)
selection.stable: valid on the 4 used dates and outside the configured E6 suspected disk (no std truncation, which would bias variance estimates)

evaluation.headline: leave-one-date-out over the 3 Wayanad pre dates (n_pre = 2 for the formula, 1 dof), pooled over the 3 folds, estimator chosen by `selection`, k = 2

statistics.effect_size_reported_against: strongest honest baseline (named per agent); always with denominator
